requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths checked

narrative.summary: PoolManager.owner() is the same cross-domain forwarder that owns the V3 Factory’s fee adapter and acts as the V2 Factory’s feeToSetter, so the root is Uniswap’s Ethereum-mainnet Governance Timelock (2-day delay, 172,800s), not a Base-side key.
narrative.tag: $59.3M Base TVL, same DAO root as V2 and V3
narrative.detail: Blast radius is narrow: the deployed source has only two onlyOwner functions, setProtocolFeeController and transferOwnership; the controller sets per-pool protocol fees (capped at 0.1% per direction by isValidProtocolFee) and collects accrued protocol fees, and PoolManager is not a proxy and has no upgrade function. Scored exactly like V2 and V3 (80 / 100 / 75), so crossExposureScore 100 means DAO-rooted targets are excluded from signer overlap, not independence from those two.
